name: Orange Trainer
source:
A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away...
You wake up in an abandoned space station, having lost most of your memories. A togruta Jedi named Ashoka and a droid called J4-S-ON are also there.
In order to repair the station, Hypermatter is needed, and although the girl is quite aggressive, there should be a way to get her to help you.
translation:
很久以前，在遥远的银河系……

你在一座废弃空间站醒来，失去了大部分记忆。这里还有名叫阿索卡的陶格鲁塔绝地，以及一台名叫J4-S-ON的机器人。

修复空间站需要超空间物质，虽然那个女孩相当好斗，但应该有办法让她帮助你。
